rule: Every command maps to exactly one pre-approved local script/action. No command accepts an arbitrary shell string. run_existing_script accepts only a scriptId from allowedScripts below, never a raw path.

run_tests.description: node scripts/check-js.js && node --test - the project's own full unit/integration suite.

run_linter.description: Reuses the same check script (this project's check-js.js is its lint/static-check gate; there is no separate lint script to duplicate).

run_benchmark.description: node scripts/collective-brain-benchmark.js - existing Collective Brain benchmark, not a new one.

build_web.description: Existing build:sentry + inject-sentry-runtime + build:posthog + inject-posthog-runtime chain.

build_native.description: No native (Godot/EXE) build/export pipeline exists anywhere in this repo (confirmed by search before writing this - no --export, electron-builder, pkg, nexe, or a native/desktop build script; scripts/godot-runtime-smoke.js only launches one scene headless as a smoke test, it does not build/export an artifact). Reports a clear unavailable status rather than fabricating one. Wire this to a real script the moment one exists - do not point it at godot-runtime-smoke.js, which is not a build.

inspect_logs.description: Reads the tail of one pre-approved status/report file - never an arbitrary path.

run_existing_script.description: Runs one pre-approved script by scriptId - never a raw path from the task.

apply_patch.description: Applies a unified diff to an isolated worktree ONLY (never the main tree), after `git apply --check` validates it cleanly. Requires verify_patch afterward before any promotion. Gated by collective-brain policyGate('remote-task:apply_patch') which requires COLLECTIVE_BRAIN_HUMAN_APPROVED=1 (see collective-brain-policy.json's approvalRequiredOperations). Accepts an optional args.fixMetadata ({id, rootCause, solution, protection[], evidence[]}); if the matching verify_patch on the same targetWorktree then succeeds, the fix is auto-registered via collective-brain-register-fix.js.

verify_patch.description: Runs the same test suite as run_tests, scoped to args.targetWorktree if given (the worktree a patch was applied to).

run_integration_tests.description: playwright test e2e/golden-release.spec.js - the existing Golden Standard end-to-end/integration suite, not a new one.

run_release_gate.description: The existing full ~24-step release gate chain (desktop-ai, tests, golden, quality, tech, contracts, collective-brain, etc). Long-running (several minutes).

run_visual_regression.description: node scripts/visual-regression.js - the existing visual regression gate.

run_performance_benchmark.description: lhci autorun against lighthouserc.cjs - the same Lighthouse config CI's own `lighthouse` job already uses. Distinct from run_benchmark, which is collective-brain's own internal (redaction/routing/event-chain) benchmark.

read_ci_status.description: Read-only: `gh run list --limit 5` for the current repo, via whatever `gh` auth already exists on the machine running this bridge. Never receives or forwards any credential to the task requester. Returns {configured:false} honestly if `gh` isn't authenticated on this host instead of failing unclearly.

read_deployment_status.description: Read-only: current git HEAD/branch plus the last 5 merged PRs (`gh pr list --state merged --limit 5`), via whatever `gh` auth already exists on the machine running this bridge. This is git/PR history, not a live Vercel deployment poll - no Vercel token is introduced by this bridge.

known_issues_lookup.description: Keyword-matches args.query against data/error-prevention-registry.json's knownErrors (the same data collective-brain:recall already reads) and returns the best matches with their root cause/solution/protection - read-only, no execution.

health_status.description: Reports this bridge's own health: whether its watchdog-supervised worker process is alive and recently active (via collective-brain-remote-bridge-watchdog.js --healthcheck), plus the collective-brain audit-event-chain integrity.

route_goal.description: Wraps the existing lib/collective-brain routeTask() keyword-weighted scorer: given args.goal, returns the ranked recommended agent(s) from data/collective-brain/agent-capabilities.json. Recommendation only - does not itself execute. For an actual free-tier code-editing execution, use agent_implement, which really does dispatch to OpenCode with a free model (verified working); AnythingLLM/OpenHuman still have no safe invocation surface on this host and are not dispatched to.

create_worktree.description: Creates a fresh, isolated git worktree off origin/master under the OS temp directory (self-cleaning, never inside the visible repo tree) with a new ai/agent-invoke/<name>-<timestamp> branch. args: {name}. Returns {worktreePath, branch}. This is the isolation boundary every other agent_* command below requires.

remove_worktree.description: Removes an isolated worktree created by create_worktree (git worktree remove --force). args: {targetWorktree}. Refuses the main tree (same guard as apply_patch).

inspect_worktree_diff.description: Read-only `git diff --stat` + full diff for one isolated worktree. args: {targetWorktree}.

agent_implement.description: Real free-tier code-editing execution: given args.goal and args.targetWorktree (from create_worktree), runs OpenCode CLI non-interactively against a free hosted model (opencode/mimo-v2.5-free, then 2 other free models as fallback if the first fails/times out/produces no useful change/fails verification), verifies the result with `npm run check` in that worktree, and returns the verified diff. Never touches the main tree. Per-worktree lease prevents two agent_implement/agent_autofix calls editing the same worktree concurrently. Every argument that reaches the underlying process is either a fixed literal, a vetted free-model name, or a generated temp-file path - the goal text itself is never placed on a command line, it is written to a temp file and attached, eliminating shell-injection risk. If every free model fails, returns needsEscalation:true with full diagnostics instead of silently failing or auto-invoking a paid model.

agent_autofix.description: Runs `npm run check` in args.targetWorktree; if it already passes, returns immediately with nothing to do. If it fails, builds a goal from the real failure output and calls agent_implement's same free-tier fallback chain to fix the root cause (not just delete/skip the failing test) and re-verify.

prepare_commit_and_pr.description: Commits args.targetWorktree's changes, pushes the branch, and opens a real PR against master via `gh pr create` (args: {targetWorktree, title, body}). This reaches the public GitHub repo, so it is gated the same way apply_patch is - see collective-brain-policy.json's approvalRequiredOperations (remote-task:prepare_commit_and_pr). Still only opens a PR; merging to master still requires the existing PR -> CI -> gates -> merge-on-green flow, which this command cannot bypass.

ai_query.description: Read-only Q&A/analysis against a local Ollama model (qwen3:4b by default) on this host - genuinely local, zero network egress beyond localhost, zero cost. For classification/explanation/lookup tasks, not code editing (no tool-execution harness is built around Ollama here - see agent_implement for real code changes).

restart_known_worker.description: Restarts exactly one pre-registered named worker via its own watchdog script's --restart mode.
